elevation_calibration.calculation: (690 - landmark_y) / ((690-246)/14.98); estimates rounded, perspective/ground uncertainty approximately 0.35 m.

roof_calibration.method: Scale relative to 7 m frontage and cross-check quarter-turn obliques; photogrammetry displaced roof edges and unknown roof overhangs limit estimates.
roof_calibration.warning: Front roof pitch and stepped rear roof are interpreted approximate planes, not survey. Rear ground perimeter cannot be certified from roof projection.

registration.basis: Existing Coffee King passage reservation fixed; extend 7 m southwest along frontage. No change to passage or courtyard reservation.

shop_depth_conflict: 33.90 m agent figure not imposed as full-height geometry; rear envelope terminates at 30.8 m on existing provisional block. Future measured plan may revise it.
